title: ConsumerFeedback
description: Meta-schema for the consumer feedback runtime message (Welle 2; loadedCommit Block B, 24.09.). A wire message, not a repo object: no route in validate-all.mjs, no folder. grain: loaded reports the model state in effect in the process, as loadedVersion (a released UNSaC version) OR loadedCommit, optionally with loadedDigest (the content of its scope; same digest as the rolled-out release = same content) (the full commit of the osf-schemas tree it loaded; the receiver resolves it through its release tags unsac/<version>, and a commit without a release tag is drifting, never unknown and never in agreement). grain: seen reports a window of observed UNS subjects.

loadedDigest.description: Optional content digest of the consumer's SCOPE as loaded (Block B). Scope = every *.json file below each reads[] entry that ends in / (recursively), each reads[] entry that names a file, and the file below sources/ declaring each sourceId of carries[]; each file once. Digest = 'sha256:' + lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 text made of one pair of lines per scope file, the files in ascending code-unit order of their path: '<path>\n<lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file's raw bytes>\n', path relative to the tree root with / separators. An empty scope has no digest. Equal to the digest of the rolled-out release for this consumer = same content (in agreement) even on another commit; without it the commit or version decides.

loadedCommit.description: Full lowercase commit of the osf-schemas tree in effect in the process; never abbreviated (a short SHA can be ambiguous).
